title: navigationClick
summary: Check whether an anchor click is eligible for client-side routing.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: Pass the native MouseEvent and the anchor element. For React events, pass event.nativeEvent and event.currentTarget.

sections.title: Returns
sections.body: Returns false for an already prevented event, a non-primary button, any modifier key, a download attribute, or a target other than an empty target or _self. Otherwise returns true.

sections.title: Example
sections.body: The helper only checks browser interaction semantics. Resolve and check the destination before preventing the default behavior.

sections.title: Scope
sections.body: Does not prevent default, stop propagation, inspect route existence, check same-origin URLs, or perform navigation. Link already combines these responsibilities; use this helper only when implementing an application-owned anchor integration.
